title: How do I avoid overdraft fees on my Blue Account?
summary: This document explains that the overdraft fee on a Blue Account is $0.00. It provides steps to avoid overdraft situations anyway: set low-balance alerts at $62, review pending charges regularly, and schedule deposits/transfers to arrive before your balance reaches $62.
